name: Future Mod
description: Frame window counter for GD: a CBF-aware macro bot that measures every click's frame window, NaN-style replay rings, frame windows on death, NaNDL comparison, plus optional cheat modules (click indicator, click practice, LDM instaswap). Also: skip level endings with a key.

skip-end.name: Exit Level Ending
skip-end.description: Press this while a level is finishing to instantly exit the level, skipping the end animation, the delay, and the completion screen. The level still counts as completed. Only active during the ending, so it's safe to set to your jump key (e.g. Space).

macro-enabled.name: Enable macro features
macro-enabled.description: Master switch for the macro bot, frame window analysis, playback display, death display and the cheat modules. Off = all of it is disabled; 'Exit Level Ending' keeps working.

macro-record.name: Record
macro-record.description: Start / stop recording your inputs (normal mode). Works with Click Between Frames and from start positions (each start position gets its own macro). Recording restarts when you die, so it keeps the attempt you complete.

macro-play.name: Replay
macro-play.description: Replay the recorded macro, with frame window rings if it has been analyzed.

macro-analyze.name: Analyze frame windows
macro-analyze.description: Measure every input's frame window. Hands off while it runs; no noclip/speedhack, and turn off CBF's Physics Bypass. Results: rings on replay, the death display, the NaNDL comparison, and export files (pause menu > Files).

analyze-releases.name: Analyze releases too
analyze-releases.description: Also measure the timing window of RELEASES (letting go), not just presses. Wave/ship straight-flying is mostly release timing. Short taps are measured as one gesture either way. Turn off for cube-only levels to halve analysis time.

fw-max-window.name: Max window (frames)
fw-max-window.description: Windows wider than this many 240 Hz frames are reported as 'wide' (not a timing) and stop being probed. 10 matches NaN's lists; lower = faster analysis.

fw-subframe.name: Sub-frame precision (CBF)
fw-subframe.description: On CBF runs, every input's window is measured below one frame (as NaN does): each edge is narrowed this many times. 5 = edges to 1/64 frame (about two decimals, NaN measures to 0.01), 3 = 1/16, 0 = whole frames only. Each step costs two extra runs per input. Has no effect on runs recorded without CBF.

fw-ring-size.name: Ring size
fw-ring-size.description: How big the frame window rings and their numbers are, on replay and on death. 1 = normal, 0.5 = half, 2 = double. Applies live.

fw-ring-pop.name: Ring pop-in animation
fw-ring-pop.description: Rings scale up quickly when they appear. Turn off to have them appear instantly at full size.

fw-rings.name: Frame window rings
fw-rings.description: During macro playback (K), draw a ring on the player at every analyzed click and release, the moment it happens, labelled with its frame window and coloured by it (red = tight, green = loose; pink = sub-frame with CBF). A counter in the top-left shows how many inputs of each window you've passed so far. Same display as NaN GD's frame window videos. Run the analyzer (N) once first so the windows are known.

fw-sound.name: Frame window sound
fw-sound.description: Play a sound on every analyzed input during playback. Its pitch follows the window: a 1-frame input is the lowest note and each extra frame steps it up, so you can hear how tight a section is.

fw-sound-file.name: Sound file
fw-sound-file.description: A GD sound name (e.g. counter003.ogg, playSound_01.ogg), a file you put in this mod's config folder, or a full path to an .ogg/.mp3/.wav. Falls back to playSound_01.ogg if it can't be found.

fw-sound-volume.name: Sound volume
fw-sound-volume.description: Volume of the frame window sound (also scaled by GD's SFX volume).

death-windows.name: Show on death
death-windows.description: When you die while playing normally: 'Died-on click' puts a frame window ring where you made the click you died on (the latest click whose window had opened when you died). 'All' rings every click you passed this attempt. Uses your analysis of the level or imported windows. Rings stay until your next attempt.

death-nandl.name: Use NaNDL when a level has no windows
death-nandl.description: If a level has no analysis and nothing imported, show NaN's window totals from nandl.pages.dev for a few seconds when you die (the only text shown on death: NaNDL has no per-click windows to put a ring on).

nandl-compare.name: Compare with NaNDL after analysis
nandl-compare.description: When an analysis finishes on a level that's listed on nandl.pages.dev, show NaN's frame window counts next to yours. Turn off to skip the popup; the pause menu NaNDL button still works.

nandl-name.name: NaNDL level name
nandl-name.description: The level's name on nandl.pages.dev, if it differs from its name in GD. Leave blank to use the GD name. Used by the NaNDL comparison after an analysis and by the pause menu NaNDL button.

mod-click-indicator.name: Click indicator
mod-click-indicator.description: CHEAT. A line in the level at the dead centre of every upcoming click's frame window (coloured by the window, red = tight; releases fainter). It scrolls with the level: click when your icon crosses it. Uses the level's analyzed windows (your analysis or an import). While any cheat module is on, the run is marked CHEATING and doesn't save progress.

mod-click-practice.name: Click practice
mod-click-practice.description: CHEAT. Practice only the clicks you pick (pause menu > Practice): around those, you play them yourself at their real difficulty; every other click is played by the bot from your macro, and your inputs there are ignored. Needs a recorded (and ideally analyzed) macro for the level. Marks the run as CHEATING.

practice-margin.name: Practice margin (frames)
practice-margin.description: How long before and after a picked click you're in control (frames). Must be wider than the click's window; 12 is plenty for most.

mod-ldm-swap.name: LDM instaswap
mod-ldm-swap.description: CHEAT. Bind a level to its LDM / ULDM version (pause menu > LDM), then press the key to swap between them instantly. The LDM version's own start positions are removed and replaced with the ones from the level you're on, and you stay on the start position you were on. Marks the run as CHEATING.

ldm-swap-key.name: LDM swap key
ldm-swap-key.description: Swaps between the level and the LDM version bound to it.
